title: Speaking Practice 8 - Sports and Fitness
description: IELTS Speaking Part 1: Questions about sports and physical activities.

stimuli.title: Part 1: Sports and Fitness
stimuli.content: Answer questions about sports and fitness habits.

questionGroups.instruction: Answer the following questions about sports and fitness.

questions.content: Do you play any sports regularly?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Yes, I play badminton twice a week with my friends. It's a great way to stay fit and socialize at the same time.

questions.content: What sport is most popular in your country?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Football is by far the most popular sport in Vietnam. Almost every neighborhood has a small football pitch.

questions.content: Did you play sports when you were a child?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Yes, I used to play football every afternoon after school with my classmates in the schoolyard.

questions.content: Do you prefer watching sports or playing them?

explanation.sampleAnswer: I definitely prefer playing because I enjoy the physical activity and the sense of achievement when I improve.

questions.content: Do you think children should be encouraged to do more sport?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Absolutely. Regular physical activity is essential for children's development, both physically and mentally.
explanation.tips: Give a strong opinion with health benefits
